item.title: Notchkit 0.1.6
item.description:
What's new

  • Removed the "Back to the previous app" feature: the link at the top of the expanded notch and its widget are gone.
  • Under the hood: project documentation and build cleanups.

Installation

If you already have Notchkit 0.1.5, it offers this update by itself (or use Check for Updates… in its menu).

Otherwise, download Notchkit-0.1.6.dmg, open it, and drag Notchkit.app onto the Applications shortcut. Notchkit isn't notarized yet: the first time, right-click the app > Open.

Requires macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel.

item.title: Notchkit 0.1.5
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates: Notchkit now checks for a new version once a day and installs it with your approval. You can also use Check for Updates… in its menu, or turn automatic checks off in Settings > General. This is the last version you need to download by hand.
  • New app icon: a Mac screen with a vivid wallpaper and the notch.

Installation

Download Notchkit-0.1.5.dmg, open it, and drag Notchkit.app onto the Applications shortcut. Notchkit isn't notarized yet: the first time, right-click the app > Open.

Requires macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel.
